I have enough evidence. The `dffa2a5298` commit is the sole introducer of the buggy loop, and `d42833f3ee9487bcb20005a3af611d609e32ae60` also touched this file later but let me verify it didn't modify this specific loop (already confirmed by the earlier grep — only the two commits touched `setName(course...)`).

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: dffa2a5298ca0540313fbae53788c9842eab2cdf

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I ran `git log -p --follow` on `StudentSectioningDatabaseLoader.java` and searched for the exact line removed by the fix (`section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), c.getClassSuffix(course));`). This line only appears in two commits in the whole history: the bug-fixing commit `46eeb00df` (where it's removed/guarded) and one earlier commit, `dffa2a5298` (where it's added).

**(2) Specific change:** Commit `dffa2a5298` ("Batch Student Scheduling: Section Names - include course-dependent section names (e.g., CRNs) in the model") added:
```java
for (CourseOffering course: io.getCourseOfferings())
    section.setName(course.getUniqueId(), c.getClassSuffix(course));
```
with no null-check on the return value of `getClassSuffix(course)`. This is exactly the code that the fixing commit later guarded with `if (suffix != null)`.

**(3) Supporting evidence:** `getClassSuffix(CourseOffering)` (`Class_.java:1672`) delegates to `ExternalClassNameHelperInterface`, whose default implementation (`DefaultExternalClassNameHelper.getClassSuffix`) simply returns `clazz.getClassSuffix()` — a class-suffix field that is nullable in the data model. So `c.getClassSuffix(course)` can legitimately return `null`, which then gets passed straight into `section.setName(...)`, matching the bug described in the fix commit message ("adding text to an XML document must not be null"). The same commit also modified `XSection.java` to copy `iNameByCourse` during passivation/externalization, which is the code path affected by null names on XML export — consistent with the fix's stated purpose.

I'm confident in this identification: it is the only commit in the file's history that introduces this exact unguarded call, and the fix commit's diff is a near-exact reversal/guard of that same line.
